documented_transform.agents: identity (byte-for-byte copy of .claude/skills/<skill>; no text substitution). .agents is a DERIVED tree, regenerated via `rsync -a --delete .claude/skills/ .agents/skills/`, never hand-edited.
documented_transform.codex-installed: identity (byte-for-byte copy of .claude/skills/<skill>), excluding generated provenance.json. Installed into $CODEX_HOME/skills/<skill>.

classification_rule: In-contract = every canonical .claude/skills/<skill> is projected byte-for-byte to .agents/skills/<skill>. A skill marked claude_only:true gets NO .agents projection (none today). codex-installed is declared only for skills currently installed in $CODEX_HOME.

loader_contract.install_boundary: Canonical source (.claude/skills), the derived .agents provider tree, and installed Codex projections are tracked separately. .agents is a byte-for-byte derived tree of .claude/skills. The installed Codex projection at $CODEX_HOME/skills/<skill> must also exist and match byte-for-byte (excluding provenance.json) for acceptance checks where declared.
